rows.metric_zh: 导通/关断交叠能量积分误差
rows.reference_en: Closed-form exponential current moments and nonlinear Miller charge/energy primitives; all 18 Vin/temperature cases, both edges.
rows.reference_zh: 指数电流矩与非线性Miller电荷/能量原函数的闭式积分；18种电压/温度、两个边沿。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: Display density is unchanged; improved metrics use stage-wise 32-point Gauss quadrature. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 显示密度不变；改进指标按阶段使用32点Gauss积分。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

rows.metric_zh: 周期电感伏秒平衡残差
rows.reference_en: Exact piecewise-constant voltage integral is zero by duty construction; all 18 cases.
rows.reference_zh: 占空比构造使分段常数电压积分精确为零；全部18工况。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: Analytical trajectory already at floating-point floor; no meaningful 10% reduction claimed. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 解析轨迹已达浮点误差底限，不宣称有意义的10%降低。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

rows.metric_zh: 周期自举最低电压残差
rows.reference_en: Analytical affine cycle-map fixed point versus end-of-run minimum, including finite-cycle settling; all 36 cases.
rows.reference_zh: 解析仿射周期映射不动点与末周期最低值比较，包含有限周期建立残差；全部36工况。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: Exact exponential updates already settle below the stated floor. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 精确指数递推的建立残差已低于给定底限。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

rows.reference_en: Linear-RC ramp response evaluated with the stable expm1 expression; all 12 weak/strong-receiver cases.
rows.reference_zh: 采用数值稳定expm1表达式的线性RC斜坡响应；全部12种强/弱接收端工况。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: The peak is analytic already; this does not validate real logic clamps or CMTI. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 峰值已为解析值；这不验证实际逻辑钳位或CMTI。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

rows.metric_zh: 导出比较器跳变时刻误差
rows.reference_en: Closed-form one-pole threshold crossing plus the same 35ns assumed propagation delay; all three temperatures.
rows.reference_zh: 单极点阈值交越闭式解加相同35ns假定传播延迟；全部三个温度。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: This improves sampled waveform event placement; the analytic trip_time_s metric was already exact. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 改善采样波形的事件定位；原解析trip_time_s指标已精确。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

rows.metric_zh: 首次欠压锁定使能时刻误差
rows.reference_en: Capacitor ramp time Caux*9V/(Istart-Ioff), while original compliance remains inactive; all 18 cases.
rows.reference_zh: 原模型未进入顺从电压限制时，电容斜坡时间Caux×9V/(Istart−Ioff)；全部18工况。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: Event-aligned segments are exact only in the explicitly checked constant-current domain. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 仅在明确检查的恒流工作域内，事件对齐分段解是精确的。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

rows.metric_zh: 阻尼耗散能量积分误差
rows.reference_en: Initial minus final stored LC energy from the analytical free response; all 12 cases.
rows.reference_zh: 解析自由响应的初始与末时刻LC储能之差；全部12工况。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: Energy uses Simpson quadrature on a 4x finer internal grid; saved waveform density and analytical physics are unchanged. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 能量采用加密4倍内部网格上的Simpson积分；保存波形密度与解析物理不变。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

rows.reference_en: Independent closed-form overlap, exact piecewise-linear RMS moments, same nine loss terms, and bracketed thermal-root bisection; all 18 cases.
rows.reference_zh: 独立闭式交叠能量、分段线性电流的精确均方矩、相同九项损耗及热根区间二分法；全部18工况。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: No new physical loss term or altered Coss/Qrr accounting. The common thermal node is not a MOS junction. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 未新增物理损耗或改变Coss/Qrr核算；共用热节点不是MOS结温。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

rows.metric_zh: 输出电压轨迹最大误差
rows.reference_en: Independent adaptive Dormand-Prince 5(4), tighter run rtol=1e-11/atol=1e-13, continuous ramp and aligned load event; common 10us times, all 18 cases.
rows.reference_zh: 独立自适应Dormand-Prince 5(4)，收紧至rtol=1e-11/atol=1e-13，连续斜坡与对齐负载事件；统一10µs时刻，全部18工况。
rows.aggregation_en: Maximum absolute error over all listed case/metric comparisons.
rows.aggregation_zh: 所有列出工况及指标比较的最大绝对误差。
rows.limits_en: Reference uncertainty is the max difference from a 10x looser tolerance, an empirical convergence estimate, not a rigorous bound. New RK4 uses 0.5us steps and stage-time ramp evaluation; saved traces remain 10us. Same authored coefficients and reduced physics as V3.2; no PDK, silicon data or measured physical-accuracy claim.
rows.limits_zh: 参考不确定度为容差放宽10倍的最大差异，是经验收敛估计而非严格上界。新版RK4采用0.5µs步长并在子步时刻计算斜坡；保存间隔仍为10µs。 沿用V3.2人为系数与简化物理；无PDK、硅数据或实测物理准确度声明。

claim_en: Measured reduction of selected numerical errors only; physical accuracy is uncalibrated.
claim_zh: 仅衡量指定数值误差的降低；物理准确度未经校准。
